name: MakerBot Replicator 2X 1 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; Koordinaten: Bettecke (Exporter verschiebt um -123 / -76)
G162 X Y F2000 ; home XY axes maximum
G161 Z F900 ; home Z axis minimum
; MB_NATIVE G92 Z-5 ; set Z to -5
G1 Z0.0 F900 ; move Z to '0'
G161 Z F100 ; home Z axis minimum
M132 X Y Z A B ; Recall stored home offsets
; MB_NATIVE G92 X152 Y72 Z0 A0 B0 ; define home position (s3g Replicator2X.json)
G1 X11 Y3 Z150 F3300.0 ; move to waiting position
G130 X20 Y20 A20 B20 ; Lower stepper Vrefs while heating
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] T0 ; Set platform (bed) temperature
M134 T0 ; Wait for platform to reach temperature
M135 T0 ; Load right Toolhead
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set right extruder temperature
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T1 ; Set left extruder temperature
M133 T0 ; Wait for right Toolhead
M133 T1 ; Wait for left Toolhead
G130 X127 Y127 A127 B127 ; Set Stepper motor Vref to defaults
; Anker rechter Extruder (MiracleGrue anchorExtrusionAmount/anchorWidth)
M135 T0
G1 X12.6 Y2 Z0.2 F3300
G92 E0
G1 E10 F120 ; Blob, 10 mm bei 2 mm/s
G1 X82.6 Y2 E21.641 F900
G92 E0
; Anker linker Extruder (MiracleGrue anchorExtrusionAmount/anchorWidth)
M135 T1
G1 X12.6 Y6 Z0.2 F3300
G92 E0
G1 E10 F120 ; Blob, 10 mm bei 2 mm/s
G1 X82.6 Y6 E21.641 F900
G92 E0
M135 T0
machine_end_gcode:
M18 A B ; Turn off A and B Steppers
G1 Z155 F900
G162 X Y F2000
M18 X Y Z ; Turn off steppers after a build
M140 S0 T0
M104 S0 T0
M70 P5 ; We <3 Making Things!
M72 P1 ; Play Ta-Da song
